Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

Can’t find yours? WhatsApp us any time.

How do I place an order?

Tap Order Now, choose your item and location, and your order opens in WhatsApp ready to send. You can also call 0740 338839.

Where do you deliver?

Across Nairobi and surrounding neighbourhoods such as Kilimani and Ongata Rongai, from the kitchen in Kiserian.

Do you cook at my home?

Yes — the housecall service covers large meals and complete week-long meal preps.

Can I order for an event?

Absolutely. Chapatis, samosas and mandazis can be pre-ordered in bulk.
